provenance.summary: Seeded from verified monitor totals for Nov 1–6, 2026 and from run-level journals whose daily sums match those totals. No X API call was made from this repository. Per-account profile rankings are omitted until a verified account export is ingested.
sources: Verified daily monitor totals: Nov 1 = 41 (40 AM + 1 PM, excluding 7 preexisting), Nov 2 = 17, Nov 3 = 13, Nov 4 = 1, Nov 5 = 378 (11 + 179 + 188), total 450 through Nov 5
